$description: Color tokens for Fernhill Bakery. Generated by Palette Engine. Light roles are in "color"; dark roles are in "color-dark" (DTCG 2025.10 defines modes in its resolver module, not in the format).

com.kwadejoslin.palette.name: Kiln Terracotta
com.kwadejoslin.palette.rationale: Fired clay and the inside of a brick oven. Chosen by the client before the project began, so it is locked and the rest of the palette is built around it.

dataset.source: Pasted by the designer; Palette Engine bundles no Pantone data

evidence.claim: Color supplied by the designer. No research claim is attached to it.

com.kwadejoslin.palette.name: Harbour Teal
com.kwadejoslin.palette.rationale: Complement of the terracotta, used sparingly for links and focus states. The complement rule is low-confidence evidence; it was kept because it reads clearly against the warm seed.

dataset.source: Pasted by the designer; Palette Engine bundles no Pantone data

evidence.claim: Complementary lens on the OKLCH hue wheel, offset +180°. Classical color-wheel geometry does not predict harmony in lab studies (Schloss & Palmer); useful as designer vocabulary and for emphasis roles.

com.kwadejoslin.palette.name: Fern Green
com.kwadejoslin.palette.rationale: Named after the street. Used for success states and the seasonal menu.

dataset.source: Pasted by the designer; Palette Engine bundles no Pantone data

evidence.claim: Color supplied by the designer. No research claim is attached to it.

com.kwadejoslin.palette.name: Fernhill Bakery
statements: Print swatches are lookup-table approximations, not proofs.
Spot names are approximate and come from values the designer pasted; verify against a current physical guide under D50 light.

acceptedFailures.note: Softer outline for card borders and dividers on the menu pages. These are decorative, so WCAG 1.4.11 does not require 3:1. Do not use this color for form field borders or focus rings; use the primary role for those.
